tools.name: search_tickets
tools.description: Search support tickets by text and status. Use when the user asks to find, list or look up tickets. Read-only; returns at most 20 tickets per call and a next_cursor for more.

query.description: Text to match in title or body.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call.

tools.name: delete_ticket
tools.description: Permanently delete one ticket by id. Use when the user explicitly asks to remove a ticket. Destructive and not reversible; requires confirm set to true.

ticket_id.description: Id of the ticket to delete.

tools.name: get_server_status
tools.description: Report server version and uptime. Use when the user asks whether the server is healthy. Read-only, no arguments.
